Comment: Trigger case (absolutive) overtly marked throughout: pronouns have dedicated trigger forms (ako, ka, siya); NPs take an/su.
Pronoun table (p.81, Fig.11) shows clear ABS/ERG distinction for all persons. 1sg: ako (T) vs. ko (ERG).
2sg: ka/ika (T) vs. mo (ERG). Clear ABS/ERG distinction.
3sg: siya (T) vs. niya (ERG). Clear ABS/ERG distinction.
Personal names take si (T) vs. ni (ERG); full NPs take an/su (T) vs. ki/kan (non-trigger/ERG).
Imperfective (CV- reduplication) and perfective (-in-, pig-) both show consistent ERG alignment.
Perfective clauses consistently show ERG alignment.
ERG alignment maintained in past-tense ('commenced tense') constructions.
ERG alignment maintained in non-past ('non-commenced tense') constructions.
All declarative/indicative clauses show ERG alignment.
Non-indicative moods (commands, irrealis) maintain ERG alignment.
Realis clauses maintain ERG alignment.
Irrealis (negation, conditionals with kon, past counterfactuals) maintain ERG alignment.
Canonical agentive A consistently marked with ERG ko/ni/kan.
Perceptual and cognitive experiencers also take ERG: na-iling ko ito 'I saw that' (p.82-83, ex.76); ma-ma-mati' ito ni Andres 'Andres will hear that' (ex.84). Non-agentive A takes ERG.
Topical/trigger argument is always in ABS (trigger case); A is always non-trigger/ERG. GB409_16=0 is the canonical Philippine-type pattern.
All non-topical A arguments are ERG; every transitive example shows this pattern.
Animate A (human agents and experiencers) consistently take ERG.
No examples of inanimate A in transitive clauses in this source; value unresolvable.
Main clauses show ERG alignment throughout.
Subordinate/complement/relative clauses preserve ERG marking (pp.68, 110).
In conditional pag-clauses (p.113, ex.142), S argument takes ERG instead of expected ABS. This split intransitivity is variably present (Fincke qualifies optionality).
ERG marker (ko/ni/kan) also marks possession (p.99: su kamot ko 'my hand'; ni Mamay as possessor). Canonical Philippine ERG=GEN syncretism.
Source does not identify an instrumental case or show ERG markers glossed as instrumental; value unresolvable.
